task: October Task 1 - Encoder, Tokenizer, and Model Pre-registration

encoder.selection_rationale: Legal-BERT was selected because it is pretrained on legal text and produced fewer chunks over the 512-token limit during the token-length audit.

tokenization.token_length_source: Fresh tokenization of final chunk_text using the selected tokenizer
tokenization.oversized_chunk_policy: Re-split chunks over 512 tokens before training
tokenization.truncation: Use truncation=True only as a final safety guard
tokenization.rationale: Stored historical token counts did not always match token counts from the final chunk text, so fresh tokenizer-specific counts are used as the source of truth.

training.positive_weight_formula: number of negative training examples / number of positive training examples

compute_fallback.trigger: Compute or memory limitations only, not model performance
steps: Fall back to DistilRoBERTa if Legal-BERT still cannot train reliably

model_selection.seed_reporting: Report individual seed results plus mean and standard deviation
model_selection.test_set_usage: Official test data cannot be used for model selection

threshold_selection.final_thresholds: To be selected after training using the frozen validation rule
threshold_selection.test_set_usage: Official test data cannot be used to tune thresholds
